title: COBRA Continuation of Pharmacy Benefit Plan Coverage
content:
COBRA events on a Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment come from the sponsor's COBRA administrator. Northbridge Rx records them; it does not take elections or premiums itself.

## Terms

**Election window.** The COBRA election notice is never dated before the coverage end date, so the election window runs from the notice date. A COBRA election reinstates the enrollment only when it is received no later than the design's COBRA election window, in calendar days, after the COBRA election notice date, counted with the notice date as day zero. The notice date is read from the member's enrollment record; the last day of the window is itself on time.

**Reinstatement.** On a timely election, coverage resumes the day after the coverage end date with accumulators intact, and the enrollment moves from terminated to COBRA continuation. Continuation lasts at most the design's COBRA maximum continuation period, in months, from that day.

**Premiums and grace.** An unpaid monthly premium moves the enrollment to COBRA grace, and claims pend. A premium received within the design's COBRA premium grace period, in calendar days, of its due date restores COBRA continuation; otherwise coverage ends on the last paid-through day.

**End of continuation.** COBRA continuation also ends, and the enrollment becomes terminated, when the continuation period ends or the member drops COBRA through the administrator.

## Statuses under COBRA

| Status | Meaning | Claims |
|---|---|---|
| COBRA continuation | Coverage continued after a timely election | Adjudicate |
| COBRA grace | A monthly premium is past its due date and the grace period runs | Pend |
| Terminated | Coverage has ended: no timely election reinstated it, the premium was not received within grace, or continuation ended | — |

## Election window boundary (hypothetical notice dated 10 March, window of 60 calendar days)

Counting 10 March as day zero, 31 March is day 21, 30 April is day 51 and 9 May is day 60.

| Election received | Day count | Reinstates the enrollment |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March | Day 0 | Yes |
| 8 May | Day 59 | Yes |
| 9 May | Day 60, the last day of the window | Yes |
| 10 May | Day 61 | No |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Coverage ended on 28 February and the election notice is dated 10 March. An election received on 2 May reinstates the enrollment; coverage resumes on 1 March, the day after the coverage end date, with the deductible and out-of-pocket met before termination still counted.
